summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Indonesian subsidiary entered into additional electricity supply agreements with state-owned PLN for a planned AI data center project. The agreements establish a dual-feed power configuration rated at 55,400 kVA each, targeting a 40MW IT load. The subsidiary agreed to pay an aggregate connection fee of approximately IDR 69.9 billion plus deposits and variable charges. These are power procurement arrangements, not customer contracts, and do not guarantee project completion or revenue. This is a routine operational disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
